candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because the order service returns 502 on /v1/orders, which in turn fails because payment returns 503 on /v1/authorizations. The failure originates in the payment dependency (5xx), propagating up through order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment 503 as the deepest error, but no payment-side telemetry is available to confirm the payment fault's own cause (e.g., config, pool, latency).

report.explanation: All four checkout traces show the same chain: gateway /v1/checkout 502 -> order /v1/orders 502 -> payment /v1/authorizations 503, while inventory/reservations succeed (200). Gateway logs and metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout and client 502s to order. The deepest observed error is payment 503, so the bounded candidate is an upstream 5xx originating at payment.
